prompts.town: Create a production game sprite sheet for EMBERGRAVE, a mature dark fantasy isometric RPG. One atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, six separate objects in equal rectangular cells, row-major order. Landscape 1536x1024. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No text, labels, grid lines, scenery background, people, ground tile bases, or cast shadows extending outside objects. Each object fully isolated with 35px clear padding, centered in its own cell and aligned by base. All use the same orthographic isometric camera: 2:1 ground diamond, view from southeast, see two walls and roof, verticals upright. Beautiful detailed painted realistic game art, rich readable weathered materials, strong silhouettes, warm illuminated windows, grounded and handmade, not cartoon or low-poly. Keep all objects clear and distinct at 200px width. Six cells: TOP LEFT imposing main hall; TOP MIDDLE smaller dwelling; TOP RIGHT roofed blacksmith workshop with visible glowing forge and anvil; BOTTOM LEFT a covered market pavilion with goods; BOTTOM MIDDLE tall watchtower; BOTTOM RIGHT a standalone travel shrine of standing stones around a restrained cyan crystal, matching local craftsmanship. Theme: CINDERWATCH, autumn frontier borough. Charcoal timber framing, pale aged plaster, steep terracotta and slate roofs, amber pennants, stone foundations, the main hall has a bell turret; watchtower timber and stone. Market awnings burnt sienna. Smoke stains and firewood. No snow.

prompts.materials: Production texture atlas for an isometric dark fantasy RPG. Exactly FIVE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equally sized square material swatches, overall aspect ratio 5:2, 2560 by 1024 requested. Every cell is a flat TOP-DOWN seamless repeating texture filling its full square edge to edge; NO isometric perspective, NO tile bevels, NO borders or gaps, NO lighting gradients, NO text, NO props, NO symbols. Small detailed realistic painted material texture with consistent subtle ambient daylight. Order LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP ROW: 1 warm weathered closely fitted dark grey cobblestone paving with muted brown dust in joints, 2 closely fitted northern slate paving with very slight frost in joints but mostly bare grey stones, 3 weathered dark brown wooden boardwalk planks with subtle grain and iron nail heads, 4 closely fitted golden sandstone paving, 5 closely fitted charred basalt block paving with very subtle reddish dust joints, NO lava glow. BOTTOM ROW LEFT TO RIGHT: 1 earthy brown mossy short grass with scattered autumn leaves, 2 packed soft off-white snow with faint wind texture, 3 damp mossy muted green-brown marsh soil with tiny reeds lying flat, 4 pale warm sandy desert soil with subtle small pebbles, 5 charcoal volcanic ash soil with scattered dark gravel. Road stones about 20-35 stones across each square. Each square internally evenly lit, continuous physical material, understated natural texture, no large clumps or decorative focal points. Image is a texture library asset; square crops will tile continuously in game.
